post_update_notes: After this update finishes, run these three ONE-TIME commands to backfill new data (all idempotent — safe to re-run, but NOT auto-run on every future update since each one overwrites values an admin may later customize by hand): `php artisan db:seed --class=RolesSeeder` (grants the new bulk-update-products sub-permissions to existing roles), `php artisan db:seed --class=SettingsSeeder` (adds the new Country-Based VAT toggle and Social Login settings keys), and `php artisan db:seed --class=TaxRatesSeeder` (seeds starting EU/EEA VAT rates — verify every rate before enabling Country-Based VAT on the Tax Settings page). If your shipping zone has zero countries assigned, open it in the admin and click "Add All EU/EEA Countries" (Countries tab) instead of re-running ShippingZonesAndMethodsSeeder, which truncates and rebuilds your whole shipping setup. Running Nginx? Copy deploy/nginx/oeparts.conf and deploy/php-fpm/oeparts-pool-overrides.conf — see README's new "Web server" section.
